name: FreeConference.com
description_en:
FreeConference.com, a service of iotum, combines telephone conference calling with browser-based video meetings. Those participant types have different plan limits. It is a different product from the similarly named FreeConferenceCall.com.

A host should count telephone callers, web participants, premium dial-in minutes and recording storage separately. The homepage’s broad free-conferencing wording does not establish a hundred free video participants.
description_zh:
FreeConference.com 是 iotum 的服务，结合电话会议及浏览器视频会议，两类参与者有不同套餐限制。它与名称相近的 FreeConferenceCall.com 是不同产品。

主持人应分别计算电话参会者、网页参会者、付费拨入分钟及录制存储。首页广义免费会议措辞不代表免费支持一百位视频参与者。

core_features.explanation_en: Participants can join through the browser or a dial-in route with different capacities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 参与者可经浏览器或拨入路径参会，容量不同。

core_features.explanation_en: Starter lists audio recording; Pro adds audio/video recording and transcription.
core_features.explanation_zh: Starter 列出音频录制，Pro 加音视频录制及转写。

en: Create a host account, share the room URL and provide the appropriate dial-in number/access code to a phone guest. For Free, the plan page lists up to five web participants and one hundred callers. Confirm how a person joining twice is counted. Test screen share, mute and guest entry before an important discussion. This scenario was not executed.
zh: 创建主持人账户、分享房间网址，并向电话访客提供适当号码/接入码。Free 套餐页列出最多五位网页参与者及一百位电话参会者。应确认同一人用两种方式加入如何计数，并在重要讨论前测试共享、静音和访客进入。本次未执行。

sections.title_en: Example: a small browser meeting with a phone guest
sections.title_zh: 示例：带电话访客的小型网页会议
sections.en:
Create a host account, share the room URL and provide the appropriate dial-in number/access code to a phone guest. For Free, the plan page lists up to five web participants and one hundred callers. Confirm how a person joining twice is counted. Test screen share, mute and guest entry before an important discussion. This scenario was not executed.

Do not assume every number is toll-free to a participant: premium/toll-free pools and the caller’s telecom charges require separate checks.
sections.zh:
创建主持人账户、分享房间网址，并向电话访客提供适当号码/接入码。Free 套餐页列出最多五位网页参与者及一百位电话参会者。应确认同一人用两种方式加入如何计数，并在重要讨论前测试共享、静音和访客进入。本次未执行。

不能认定每个号码对参与者免费：高级/免费拨号额度及来电者电信费用需分别核对。

sections.en:
Starter lists $9.99 monthly with one hundred web/call participants, 100 premium minutes and 5GB audio storage; Pro lists $29.99, 250 web/call participants, 750 premium minutes and 10GB recording storage. Currency code and final tax were not confirmed. Premium usage counts per minute per caller; the table lists overage rates of .10 and .06 respectively.

The homepage FAQ says Starter has fifteen web participants and a twelve-hour call maximum, while the plan page says one hundred and no time limits. Those discrepancies need account confirmation. Use neither the larger capacity nor unlimited duration as an unconditional promise.
sections.zh:
Starter 列出每月 $9.99，一百位网页/电话参与者、100 高级分钟及 5GB 音频存储；Pro 为 $29.99、250 位、750 高级分钟及 10GB 录制存储。未确认货币代码及最终税费。高级用量按每分钟每来电者计算，表格分别列出 .10 与 .06 的超额费率。

首页 FAQ 却写 Starter 十五位网页参与者、通话上限十二小时，套餐页写一百位及无时间限制。这些矛盾需账户确认，不能无条件承诺较大容量或无限时长。

sections.title_en: Host controls and the boundary of free use
sections.en:
Occasional small meetings can evaluate Free; larger video audiences and saved recordings require plan checks. If recording fails, inspect the recording artifact and storage before promising delivery; successful attendance is a different outcome. Configure admission/lock controls and consent as appropriate.

No call, recording, dial-in billing, restore or security behavior was tested. This is a managed service; no self-hosted distribution or software licence was verified. The privacy statements on marketing and cookie text also require a dedicated contract review before a sensitive workflow.
sections.zh:
偶尔小型会议可评估 Free，较大视频观众及保存录制需核对套餐。录制失败时，应检查实际文件和存储后再承诺交付；参会成功是另一结果。应适当配置进入/锁定控制及同意。

未测试通话、录制、拨入账单、恢复或安全行为。服务为托管模式，未核实自托管发行版或软件许可。敏感流程还需单独核对营销及 Cookie 文本中的隐私陈述与合同。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Starter web capacity and maximum duration conflict across official pages; currency, telecom costs, recording and contractual terms need checking.
research_gaps.zh: Starter 网页容量及最长时长在官方页面间矛盾，货币、电信费用、录制及合同需确认。
